descriptionByLocale.de:
Die Gelegenheit In unserem BiMOS Backend Werk in Lenzburg, der Schweiz und der Power Semiconductor Fabrik in Prag, Tschechien, fertigen wir effiziente, hochwertige Leistungshalbleiter für den Einsatz in Motorsteuergeräten, Traktionsanwendungen, Industrieanwendungen und Wechselrichtersystemen. Auf diese Weise leisten wir einen entscheidenden Beitrag, um die Industrie, den öffentlichen und privaten Verkehr energieeffizienter zu gestalten, während unsere Technologie auch die Produktion und den Transport erneuerbarer Energien vom Produktionsstandort zum Verbraucher ermöglicht. Eine neue Produktionsstätte wird in Prag für einen unserer Originalausrüstungshersteller (OEM) Produkte errichtet. Diese Bewegung wird durch Überlegungen von Kapazität und Unternehmenskontinuität motiviert. Im Rahmen Ihres Praktikums in der Produktionsentwicklung unterstützen Sie den Transfer von Produktionsmöglichkeiten von Lenzburg nach Prag. Sie spielen eine wichtige Rolle bei der Erleichterung der Einführung und Aufrüstung von Hitachi Energy Semiconductors Produkten auf unserem zweiten Produktionsstandort in Prag \/ Tschechische Republik.
• Ihre Aufgaben konzentrieren sich auf die Sicherstellung operativer Exzellenz, Prozessintegrität und effektiven Wissenstransfer über Standorte. Wie Sie einen Einfluss auf die Implementierung und Qualifizierung von neuen Produktionswerkzeugen ausüben, die Leistungs- und Zuverlässigkeitsstandards erfüllen. Begleitend zur Geräteintegration sowie zur Erfassung und Analyse von Produktions- und Prozessdaten Prozessqualitätskontrollverfahren und entsprechende Regelkreise zur Aufrechterhaltung der Produktkonsistenz und Compliance Organisation und Unterstützung der Ausbildung von neuen Produktionspersonal, um einen effektiven Wissenstransfer vom Standort Lenzburg zur neuen Fabrik zu gewährleisten. Ihr Hintergrund Studieningenieurwesen, Physik, Chemie, Produktionstechnik oder verwandten Disziplinen; ein Bachelor-Abschluss ist bevorzugt. Die Aufgabe kann Teil einer Masterarbeit sein Zeige echtes Interesse an der Halbleiter-Backend-Herstellung, einschließlich Bereichen wie innovative Prozesse, Logistik und Governance Zeige effektive Kommunikationsfähigkeiten für die Zusammenarbeit mit verschiedenen Stakeholdern und funktionsübergreifenden Teams, sowie ein Interesse an internationaler Zusammenarbeit und Wissensaustausch. Mastering of German ist ein Vorteil Mehr über uns Dieses Praktikum bietet praktische Erfahrungen mit Fertigungsprozessen und operativen Exzellenz in einer führenden Leistungshalbleiterumgebung. Es bietet die Möglichkeit, technische und organisatorische Fähigkeiten zu entwickeln und eine große industrielle Expansion in der Schweiz und in der Tschechischen Republik zu unterstützen. Wir freuen uns auf Ihre Bewerbung, einschließlich eines kurzen Briefes und einer Abschrift von Aufzeichnungen, zusammen mit Ihrem Lebenslauf. Nicht-EU\/EFTA-Bürger, bitte beachten Sie, dass ein offizielles Hochschulzertifikat, das zeigt, dass ein Praktikum ein obligatorischer Teil Ihres Studiums ist erforderlich.
descriptionByLocale.fr:
L'opportunité Dans notre usine BIMOS Backend à Lenzburg, en Suisse, et dans notre usine de semiconducteurs de puissance à Prague, en République tchèque, nous fabriquons des semiconducteurs de puissance efficaces et de haute qualité pour une utilisation dans les unités de commande de moteurs, les applications de traction, les applications industrielles et les systèmes d'onduleur. De cette façon, nous contribuons de manière décisive à rendre l'industrie, les transports publics et privés plus économes en énergie, tandis que notre technologie permet également la production et le transport d'énergie renouvelable du site de production au consommateur. Une nouvelle installation de production est en cours d'installation à Prague pour l'un de nos fabricants d'équipement d'origine (OEM). Cette évolution est motivée par des considérations de capacité et de continuité des opérations. Dans le cadre de votre stage en développement de la production, vous assisterez au transfert des capacités de production de Lenzburg à Prague. Vous jouez un rôle essentiel pour faciliter l'introduction et la montée en puissance des produits Hitachi Energy Semiconductors sur notre deuxième site de fabrication à Prague \/ République tchèque.
• Vos responsabilités visent à assurer l'excellence opérationnelle, l'intégrité des processus et un transfert efficace des connaissances entre les lieux. Comment vous aurez un impact Soutenir la mise en oeuvre et la qualification de nouveaux outils de production, s'assurer qu'ils répondent aux normes de performance et de fiabilité Aider à l'intégration des équipements ainsi que la collecte et l'analyse des données de production et de processus Établir des procédures de contrôle de la qualité des procédés et des boucles de contrôle correspondantes pour maintenir la cohérence et la conformité des produits Organiser et appuyer la formation de nouveaux employés de production, assurer le transfert efficace des connaissances du site de Lenzburg à la nouvelle usine Soutenir la qualification des produits en coordonnant la production d'échantillons et les activités d'essai Soutenir la mise en oeuvre de flux logistiques pour les matières premières et les pièces traitées entre Lenzburg et Prague Assurer une documentation complète et précise des procédés, des instructions de travail, des matériaux de soutien, des outils de production et de leurs configurations pour soutenir l'excellence opérationnelle et les audits futurs Votre formation Engineering, physique, chimie, technologie de production ou disciplines connexes; titulaire d'un baccalauréat est préféré. L'affectation peut faire partie de la thèse d'un maître Faire preuve d'un intérêt véritable pour la fabrication de moteurs à semi-conducteurs, y compris dans des domaines tels que les processus innovants, la logistique et la gouvernance Faire preuve d'une communication efficace pour collaborer avec diverses parties prenantes et des équipes interfonctionnelles, ainsi qu'un intérêt pour la collaboration internationale et le partage des connaissances Faire preuve d'une attention particulière au détail dans la documentation et la mise en place des processus, ainsi que des capacités organisationnelles pour appuyer la formation, la planification et le transfert des connaissances. La maîtrise de l'allemand est un avantage Plus sur nous Ce stage offre une expérience pratique des processus de fabrication et de l'excellence opérationnelle dans un environnement de semi-conducteurs de puissance de premier plan. Il offre la possibilité de développer des compétences techniques et organisationnelles tout en soutenant une expansion industrielle majeure en Suisse et en République tchèque. Nous sommes impatients de recevoir votre candidature, y compris une brève lettre de présentation et une transcription des dossiers, ainsi que votre CV. Citoyens non-UE\/AELE, veuillez noter qu'un certificat universitaire officiel indiquant qu'un stage est une partie obligatoire de vos études est requis.

jobs.title: Global Product Specialists Specialist Professional
jobs.description: The opportunity Hitachi Energy is looking for a [Global\/Regional] Product Specialist to join our innovative team in [location]. In this role, you will play a key part in managing the transformers product portfolio, conducting market analysis, and supporting the development of cutting-edge products. This position not only provides a chance to expand your skills and knowledge in the energy industry but also offers the opportunity to contribute to transformative solutions that promote sustainability and advance your career in a rapidly evolving market. How you will make an impact Conduct thorough market analysis to identify trends and assess their impact on the Transformer portfolio. Provide a fresh perspective on differentiating a mature technology and product in the market by analyzing market trends, understanding customer needs, and monitoring competitors' actions with an innovative and creative approach. Evaluate technical requirements and perform competitive assessments to pinpoint product gaps and improvement opportunities. Manage and update technical specifications for existing products to ensure market competitiveness and value. Oversee performance improvement initiatives through benchmarking and quality feedback on assigned products. Ensure compliance with international regulations and industry standards throughout the product lifecycle. Support new product development by translating market requirements into actionable inputs for the product roadmap. Prepare and present technical communication materials to support product launches and enhance market positioning. Develop and deliver engaging training sessions to empower cross-functional teams with the latest product knowledge and market insights. Responsible to ensure compliance with applicable external and internal regulations, procedures, and guidelines. Living Hitachi Energy's core values of safety and integrity, which means taking responsibility for your own actions while caring for your colleagues and the business. Your background Degree in Engineering, Business Administration, Marketing, or a related field. Minimum of 5 years of experience in product management, market analysis, or a similar role within the transformers or energy industry. Strong technical understanding of energy solutions and industry technologies to effectively communicate product benefits and differentiate offerings. Proven ability to conduct market analysis and competitive assessments to drive product development. Excellent communication and presentation skills for both technical and non-technical audiences. Ability to work collaboratively across cross-functional teams and manage multiple projects simultaneously

jobs.description: Über die Position Als Montagefachkraft in der Produktion übernimmst du eine zentrale Rolle in der Fertigung unserer Produkte. Dank deiner Erfahrung erkennst du Abweichungen frühzeitig, analysierst Ursachen und unterstützt aktiv die kontinuierliche Verbesserung der Produktionsprozesse sowie die Einarbeitung neuer Mitarbeitender. Bei uns erwartet dich ein sicherer Arbeitsplatz in einem zukunftsorientierten Unternehmen, spannende Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten, ein kollegiales und wertschätzendes Arbeitsumfeld sowie attraktive Sozialleistungen.

descriptionByLocale.it: Come specialista di assemblaggio in produzione, si gioca un ruolo centrale nella produzione dei nostri prodotti. L'installazione di impianti di produzione, l'esecuzione di lavori di assemblaggio e l'assicurarsi che tutte le fasi di lavoro siano eseguite in conformità con i requisiti in materia di qualità, efficienza e sicurezza. Grazie alla vostra esperienza, riconoscete le deviazioni in anticipo, analizzate le cause e sostenete attivamente il continuo miglioramento dei processi produttivi e l'integrazione di nuovi dipendenti. Questo consente di eseguire lavori di assemblaggio e produzione secondo specifiche, istruzioni di lavoro e standard di qualità Installazione, gestione e monitoraggio di impianti di produzione e attrezzature di lavoro Assicurare un processo di produzione regolare, mantenendo il tempo, i costi e le specifiche di qualità Applicazione dei controlli di qualità, nonché l'identificazione, l'analisi e la correzione di deviazioni Spostamento, smistamento e imballaggio di materiali e prodotti finiti Documentazione dei dati di produzione per supportare l'analisi delle prestazioni Questo ti porta a lavorare con una completa esperienza tecnica e artigianale o professionale comparabile nella produzione Esperienza pluriennale nell'ambiente di produzione industriale, idealmente nell'assemblaggio o nella produzione Buona conoscenza dei processi di produzione, dei flussi di lavoro e degli strumenti Capacità di sviluppare soluzioni strutturate anche in problemi complessi Lavoro autonomo, affidabile e di qualità-consapevole Funzionamento delle competenze del Team, nonché la volontà di assumersi responsabilità e trasmettere conoscenze in funzionamento a 2 turni.
descriptionByLocale.en: As an assembly specialist in production, you play a central role in the production of our products. You set up production facilities, perform assembly work and make sure that all work steps are carried out in accordance with requirements regarding quality, efficiency and safety. Thanks to your experience, you recognize deviations early, analyze causes and actively support the continuous improvement of production processes and the incorporation of new employees. This allows you to perform assembly and production work according to specifications, work instructions and quality standards Set up, operate and monitor production facilities and work equipment Ensure a smooth production process while maintaining time, cost and quality specifications Implementation of quality controls as well as identification, analysis and correction of deviations Moving, sorting and packaging of materials and finished products Documentation of production data to support performance analysis This brings you to work with completed technical & craftsmanship or comparable professional experience in production Multiannual experience in industrial production environment, ideally in assembly or manufacturing Good knowledge of production processes, workflows and tools Ability to develop structured solutions even in complex problems Self-employed, reliable and quality-conscious functioning Team skills as well as the willingness to take responsibility and pass on knowledge in 2-shift operation More about us We are looking for a safe workplace in a future-oriented company, exciting development opportunities, a collegial and value-adding working environment and attractive social benefits.

jobs.title: Semiconductor R&D Team Manager – Bipolar Devices 80 - 100% (f/m/d)
jobs.description:
The opportunity  At Hitachi Energy , we are committed to advancing a sustainable energy future for all by empowering the brightest minds to push technological boundaries. Join a diverse global community that thrives on collaboration, innovation, and purpose. How you'll make an impact   Lead and mentor a team of R&D engineers in a collaborative environment Own the full development cycle of bipolar semiconductor devices, from concept to manufacturing transfer Define and execute R&D strategies aligned with business goals and technology roadmaps Drive research on materials, device architectures, and fabrication processes Collaborate closely with process engineering, product management, and manufacturing Track emerging technologies and market trends in power semiconductors Prepare technical documentation, presentations, and patent applications Manage projects, budgets, timelines, and quality standards   Your background PhD or Master's degree in Physics, Electrical Engineering, Materials Science, or similar discipline with strong grounding in semiconductor device physics Multiple years of experience in semiconductor R&D, including leadership responsibility Extensive hands‑on experience in power semiconductor devices (e.g. IGBTs, power MOSFETs, diodes, thyristors ) or power semiconductor applications Demonstrated ability to lead technical teams in a complex R&D environment Strong interpersonal communication, conflict resolution, and stakeholder‑management skills Passion for people leadership, innovation, and enabling others to succeed More about us     Our flexible working practices help you optimize personal and business performance while creating an environment where all employees can develop their skills and grow. 
• We offer: Discounted conditions in our daycare centres in Baden and Oerlikon  Extra days off between Christmas and New Year  50% discount on main courses at our FELFEL fridges Discount on memberships at various fitness centres  Attractive pension benefits with our company pension fund   Diversity: Promotion of diversity and inclusion and cultural offers, credit cards, petrol, etc.)  Numerous exciting career and training opportunities within Hitachi Energy

jobs.title: Senior Quality Expert – Composites Insulators High Voltage products (f/m/d)
jobs.description: The opportunity In this role you drive excellence in quality, delivery, and compliance for the supply base. Furthermore, you ensure global processes are understood and implemented by the SCM network. As Senior Quality Expert – Composites Insulators, you will work closely with Hitachi Energy High Voltage Supply Chain, Technical Center, Group Product Service Engineering, Manufacturing, Quality, and the Global SCM team on all activity required to effectively support supplier quality requirements for assigned High Voltage commodities and suppliers. This position can be fulfilled remotely within Europe - please submit your documents in English. How you'll make an impact Lead and execute PPAP qualification plans, supplier audits, surveillance programs, and process\/product verification activities. Participate in supplier technical reviews, approval processes, and internal NPI (New Product Introduction) activities. Drive process quality improvements using Hitachi Energy tools, statistical methods, and CTQ evaluations. Conduct root‑cause analyses, FMEA, and corrective\/preventive actions to ensure sustainable process improvements. Reduce Cost of Poor Quality (COPQ) based on customer and factory feedback, embedding CTQs in supplier processes. Support SQEs, Engineering, and suppliers by promoting industrial standards of excellence and best practices. Lead global activities for composites insulators, including Prior Failure Analysis (PFA) updates and special processes. Collaborate closely with Category teams to support CIPS strategies, supplier classification, selection, onboarding, and performance improvement. Your background Bachelor's degree in Engineering or a relevant technical field (Master's degree preferred). 7+ years of experience in Supplier Quality or Manufacturing Process Quality, ideally for composite insulators. Strong knowledge of PPAP, APQP, FMEA, SPC, MSA, and process capability tools. Proven auditing experience and familiarity with ISO 9001 \/ IATF 16949 quality standards. Strong analytical and problem‑solving skills, including RCA and 8D methodologies. Demonstrated ability to work in cross‑functional and global teams with strong stakeholder interaction. Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English; able to manage complex technical discussions. Willingness to travel up to 40% globally and lead activities across international supplier networks. More about us At Hitachi Energy, we know that people thrive when they have flexibility, trust, and the space to grow. Our working practices are designed to support both personal and business performance, giving you the freedom to develop your skills and shape your career. descriptionByLocale.en:
## Mansioni
- Drive excellence in quality, delivery, and compliance for the supply base
- Ensure global processes are understood and implemented by the SCM network
- Lead and execute PPAP qualification plans, supplier audits, surveillance programs, and process/product verification activities
- Participate in supplier technical reviews, approval processes, and internal NPI activities
- Drive process quality improvements using Hitachi Energy tools, statistical methods, and CTQ evaluations
- Conduct root-cause analyses, FMEA, and corrective/preventive actions
- Reduce Cost of Poor Quality (COPQ) based on customer and factory feedback, embedding CTQs in supplier processes
- Support SQEs, Engineering, and suppliers by promoting industrial standards of excellence and best practices
- Lead global activities for composites insulators, including Prior Failure Analysis (PFA) updates and special processes
- Collaborate closely with Category teams to support CIPS strategies, supplier classification, selection, onboarding, and performance improvement

## Requisiti
- Bachelor's degree in Engineering or a relevant technical field (Master's degree preferred)
- 7+ years of experience in Supplier Quality or Manufacturing Process Quality, ideally for composite insulators
- Strong knowledge of PPAP, APQP, FMEA, SPC, MSA, and process capability tools
- Proven auditing experience and familiarity with ISO 9001 / IATF 16949 quality standards
- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, including RCA and 8D methodologies
- Demonstrated ability to work in cross-functional and global teams with strong stakeholder interaction
- Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English; able to manage complex technical discussions
- Willingness to travel up to 40% globally and lead activities across international supplier networks

## Cosa offriamo
- Flexibility, trust, and the space to grow
- Freedom to develop skills and shape career
- Benefits vary by country, based on local practices and job grade

jobs.title: Test Engineer 80 - 100% (f/m/d)
jobs.description:
Die Möglichkeit   Du möchtest die Zukunft der Energie mitgestalten? In unserem Hochstromlabor arbeitest du an der Spitze technologischer Entwicklungen und trägst dazu bei, unsere Produkte sicherer und leistungsfähiger zu machen. Als Test Engineer bist du Teil eines engagierten Teams, das Prüfprozesse kontinuierlich weiterentwickelt und höchste Qualitätsstandards sicherstellt.   Das kannst du bewirken Planung von Prüfungen und Ressourcen sowie Definition von Prüfprogrammen und Spezifikationen unter Berücksichtigung aktueller internationaler Normen und kundenspezifischer 
• Anforderungen Auslegung und Überprüfung von Prüfkreisen und Versuchsanordnungen sowie Auswahl geeigneter Messmittel Durchführung von Entwicklungs- und Typprüfungen im Hochstromlabor (thermisch und dielektrisch) Sorgfältige und vollständige Dokumentation der Prüfergebnisse Zeitnahe und effiziente Erstellung von Prüfberichten Erfassung und Dokumentation der verrechenbaren Laborleistungen Kontinuierliche Optimierung von Prüf- und Arbeitsprozessen im Team Kostenkalkulation von Prüfungen und Laborleistungen sowie Erstellung von Angeboten für internationale Kunden Das bringst du mit Abgeschlossenes Studium in Elektro- oder Energietechnik (FH oder Universität) oder eine vergleichbare Ausbildung Erste Berufserfahrung im Fachbereich von Vorteil Kenntnisse im Umgang mit verschiedenen Messgeräten und -verfahren Vorzugsweise Kenntnisse im Bereich elektrischer Kontakte Interesse an der kontinuierlichen Weiterentwicklung von Laborausrüstung und Prüfprozessen Ausgeprägte Serviceorientierung mit Fokus auf Qualität und Effizienz Persönlichkeit mit guten organisatorischen Fähigkeiten Teamfähigkeit und hohe soziale Kompetenz Sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift Mehr über uns Bei Hitachi Energy setzen wir auf Zusammenarbeit, Vielfalt und Innovation. Unsere Kultur fördert den offenen Austausch von Ideen, unterstützt individuelle Entwicklung und schafft ein Umfeld, in dem unterschiedliche Perspektiven geschätzt und integriert werden. Gemeinsam gestalten wir eine nachhaltige Energiezukunft.

jobs.title: R&D and Production Engineering Specialist 80 - 100% (f/m/d)
jobs.description: The opportunity   Join our dynamic Business R&D team in Turgi, where we develop cutting-edge medium-voltage frequency converters and HVDC subsystems. You'll work in a collaborative environment with six power electronics engineers and three mechanical engineers, contributing to innovative solutions that have a global impact. This position combines 60% R&D and 40% production engineering, offering flexibility for research activities and hands-on involvement in manufacturing processes. How you'll make an impact   •  Research & Development (60%) Drive innovation in medium-voltage converter design and technology Develop and build from prototype until the final product Collaborate with global teams in Poland, Sweden, India and China Work arrangement: Flexible (remote or on-site as needed)   •  Production Engineering (40%) Ensure seamless integration of designs into manufacturing processes Optimize production workflows for efficiency and quality Provide technical support to production teams and troubleshoot issues Work arrangement: On-site presence required at our factories in Turgi and Seon Lead & implement lean management and CIP methodology   Your background   Degree in Mechanical Engineering or related field Experience in power electronics and converter technology Experience in mechanical design and development, with tools like SolidEdge, NX, SAP Knowledge of production processes and industrialization Strong analytical and problem-solving skills Excellent communication and teamwork abilities Fluent in English and German   What We Offer Our flexible working practices help you optimize personal and business performance while creating an environment where all employees can develop their skills and grow. We also offer you: Diversity: Promotion of diversity and inclusion and cultural offers Numerous exciting career and training opportunities within Hitachi Energy Discounted conditions in our daycare centres in Baden and Oerlikon Extra days off between Christmas and New Year Subsidized meals at locations with canteens Discounts on memberships at various fitness centers Additional perks such as credit cards, petrol benefits, and more Additional perks such as credit cards, petrol benefits, and more

jobs.title: Senior Key Account Manager Schweiz 80 - 100% (w/m/d)
jobs.description:
Die Möglichkeit Als Senior Key Account Manager übernehmen Sie die Verantwortung für einen strategisch bedeutenden Kunden im Bereich der Schweizer Energieinfrastruktur. Sie agieren dabei in einem anspruchsvollen, technisch geprägten Umfeld und arbeiten eng mit internen Fachbereichen zusammen, um nachhaltige Lösungen und langfristige Partnerschaften zu entwickeln. Der Schwerpunkt dieser Rolle liegt in der operativen und strategischen Betreuung des Kunden inklusive der aktiven Führung von Ausschreibungen und Angebotsprozessen.Sie fungieren als zentrale Schnittstelle zwischen Kunde und Hitachi Energy und stellen eine professionelle Zusammenarbeit auf allen relevanten Ebenen sicher. Das können Sie bewirken Gesamtverantwortung für einen strategischen Key Account im Bereich Netzinfrastrukur  (Auftragseingang, Profitabilität, Kundenzufriedenheit) Aufbau und Pflege langfristiger, belastbarer Beziehungen zu relevanten Stakeholdern des Kunden auf allen Hierarchieebenen inklusive C-Level Sicherstellung eines konsistenten, professionellen Auftritts von Hitachi Energy gegenüber einem zentralen Akteur der Schweizer Energieversorgung Aktive Mitarbeit sowie fachliche Führung lokaler Ausschreibungen (Tenders) – von der Angebotsstrategie über die Verhandlungsphase bis zum Vertragsabschluss Entwicklung und Umsetzung einer kundenspezifischen Account‑ und Wachstumsstrategie (Marktpositionierung, Pipeline, Forecast, Wettbewerbsumfeld) Enge Zusammenarbeit mit internen Business Units und Funktionen (Sales, Engineering, Projektmanagement, Service etc.) zur optimalen Lösungs‑ und Angebotsgestaltung Anwendung und Weiterentwicklung standardisierter Sales‑ und CRM‑Prozesse und ‑Tools (z. B. Salesforce, Account Pläne, KPIs) Ihr Hintergrund Abgeschlossenes Hochschulstudium im Bereich Ingenieurwesen oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation. Ergänzende Managementqualifikation wünschenswert Langjährige Erfahrung im Key Account Management oder im Vertrieb komplexer technischer Lösungen, idealerweise in den Bereichen Energieerzeugung, Übertragungs‑ und Verteilnetze, Energieversorgungsunternehmen oder Rechenzentren. Kenntnisse des Produktportfolios von Hitachi Energy sind wünschenswert. Nachgewiesene Erfahrung im Management komplexer Kundenbeziehungen sowie in der Entwicklung und Umsetzung von Vertriebsstrategien. Versiert im erfogreichen Manövrieren in den Strukturen eines Grosskonzerns und Marktführers Fundierte Erfahrung in der Bearbeitung und Führung von komplexen Ausschreibungen Fähigkeit, operativ detailnah zu arbeiten und gleichzeitig auf Top‑Management‑Ebene sicher aufzutreten Sehr gute Kenntnisse gängiger Sales‑, CRM‑ und Office‑Tools Verhandlungssichere Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift; Fließende Englischkenntnisse; Französischkenntnisse von Vorteil 
• Was wir bieten Schlüsselrolle bei einem zentralen Akteur der Schweizer Energieinfrastruktur Hoher Gestaltungsspielraum mit direktem Einfluss auf Geschäftsbeziehung und Markterfolg Enge Zusammenarbeit mit erfahrenen Expertinnen und Experten sowie Entscheidungsträgern innerhalb von Hitachi Energy Attraktive Entwicklungs‑ und Karrieremöglichkeiten in einem global führenden Technologieunternehmen Beitrag zu einer sicheren, nachhaltigen und zukunftsfähigen Energieversorgung

descriptionByLocale.it:
Mansioni

Senior Key Account Manager per la struttura energetica svizzera

Descrizione

La possibilità di assumere la responsabilità per un cliente strategico nel settore delle infrastrutture elettriche svizzere. in un ambiente impegnativo e tecnico, collaborando con i di Lavoramenti interni per sviluppare soluzioni sostenibili e partnership a lungo termine. Il focus di questo ruolo è nella gestione operativa e strategica del cliente, inclusa la guida attiva delle offerte e dei processi di gara.

Compiti

- Responsabilità completa per un account strategico nel settore delle infrastrutture di rete (entrate ordini, profitto, soddisfazione del cliente)
- Costruzione e manutenzione di relazioni a lungo termine e affidabili con i stakeholder del cliente a tutti i livelli, inclusi C-level
- Garantire un'apparenza coerente e professionale di Hitachi Energy nei confronti di un attore centrale dell'energia svizzera
- Partecipazione attiva e guida tecnica delle offerte locali (tenders) - dalla strategia dell'offerta alla fase di fino alla chiusura del contratto
- Sviluppo e implementazione di una strategia di account e crescita personalizzata per il cliente (posizionamento sul mercato, pipeline, previsioni, ambiente competitivo)
- Collaborazione stretta con le unità aziendali Internal e le funzioni (vendite, ingegneria, project management, service, ecc.) per creare le soluzioni e le offerte dirette
- Utilizzare e sviluppare di processi e strumenti di vendita e CRM standardizzati (ad esempio Salesforce, piani di account, KPI)

Requisiti

- Diploma di laurea in ingegneria o qualifica equivalente. Qualifica di gestione complementare preferibile
- Anni di esperienza nel Key Account Management o nella vendita di soluzioni complesse, preferibilmente nei settori della produzione di energia, reti di trasmissione e distribuzione, fornitori di energia o data center
- Conoscenza del portafoglio di prodotti di Hitachi Energy
- Esperienza dimostrata nella gestione di relazioni complesse con i clienti e nello sviluppo e nell'implementazione di strategie di vendita
- Esperienza nel gestire complessi processi di gara e nella guida di team di progetto
- Capacità di lavorare nei dettagli operativi e di apparire sicuro a livello di direzione
- Conoscenza avanzata degli strumenti di vendita, CRM e office (ad esempio Salesforce, Microsoft Office)
- Conoscenza fluente del tedesco parlato e scritto, inglese flute; conoscenza del francese sarebbe un vantaggio

Cosa?

- Ruolo chiave in un attore centrale delle infrastrutture elettriche elettriche
- norme libertà di progettazione con influenza diretta sulle relazioni commerciali e sul successo di mercato
- Collaborazione stretta con esperti e decisori interni di Hitachi Energy
- Possibilità di sviluppo e carriera in un'azienda tecnologica leader a livello globale
- Contribuire a una fornitura di energia sicura, sostenibile e a prova di futuro

jobs.title: SAP Business Unit Lead Service
jobs.description: The opportunity Hitachi Energy is searching for an expert SAP Business Analyst who can bridge business needs and technology by driving end-to-end ERP solutions. This role involves analyzing requirements, defining scope, and translating complex business processes into SAP module specifications, while recommending improvements that enhance efficiency and performance. As a recognized subject matter expert, you'll shape operational plans, influence leadership, and lead the development of innovative processes and standards that deliver measurable impact. Strong communication skills and the ability to align stakeholders with strategic objectives are essential for success. How you'll make an impact Establish governance and organizational frameworks  to ensure clear roles, responsibilities, and decision-making aligned with global strategies. Provide strategic oversight for global programs , ensuring adherence to standardized processes and full adoption of core systems. Gather and analyze business requirements , synthesizing input from stakeholders to align with business goals. Manage BU demand funnel toward SAP CoE  in line with business archetype. Lead process harmonization and continuous improvement , eliminating template deviations and promoting best practices across regions. Monitor business process performance  through key metrics, data analysis, and benchmarking against industry standards. Drive data governance and management , ensuring accuracy, consistency, and security across HUBs and systems. Assess and address training needs , delivering resources and sessions to enhance team competencies and performance. Champion change management initiatives , promoting global process adoption, minimizing local customizations, and securing stakeholder buy-in. Identify and mitigate risks  related to system implementations and process changes, ensuring compliance with regulatory requirements. Lead and develop global teams , fostering accountability, collaboration, and professional growth through coaching and performance management. Collaborate on budget and demand planning , share best practices, and maintain regular communication with BU management. Your background Degree in Information Technology, Engineering, Business Administration, or related field. Minimum of 10 years of progressive experience in manufacturing, operations management, or related roles, with a proven track record of leading cross-functional teams and managing global projects. Strong leadership and change management skills, with the ability to influence and motivate global teams and stakeholders. In-depth knowledge of manufacturing, sales, logistics, service processes, systems, and process improvement methodologies (Lean, Six Sigma). Excellent communication and stakeholder engagement skills, capable of effectively conveying complex concepts and securing buy-in at all organizational levels. Analytical mindset with the ability to leverage data for performance monitoring, decision-making, and continuous improvement initiatives.

jobs.title: Global Data, Analytics and Artificial Intelligence - BU Transformers
jobs.description: The opportunity Hitachi Energy is seeking a Global Data, Analytics and Artificial Intelligence Manager for the Business Unit Transformers to join our team shaping the future of energy through digital innovation, data‑driven insights, and AI‑enabled solutions. In this role, you will drive data‑ and AI‑enabled value creation by converting business strategy into prioritized AI initiatives, ensuring measurable impact across operations, decision‑making, and innovation. This position offers the opportunity to grow your career within the newly established Digital Transformation Organization, collaborate with global stakeholders, and shape the future of Transformer solutions. How you will make an impact Shape the future of data, analytics, and AI by setting a clear strategic direction that drives meaningful business outcomes at scale. Turn real business challenges into AI opportunities that improve decisions, performance, and competitive advantage. Build and lead a high‑impact AI portfolio, taking ideas from early concepts to scaled solutions that create measurable value. Champion responsible and trusted AI by embedding strong governance, ethics, and data standards into everything delivered. Elevate data as a strategic asset by improving quality, consistency, and access to enable powerful insights and AI solutions. Lead diverse, cross‑functional teams to deliver AI initiatives that are practical, scalable, and business‑ready. Learn from results to continuously refine approaches, scale successes, and amplify business impact. Build strong partnerships with business and digital leaders to align priorities and accelerate AI adoption. Strengthen organizational capabilities through targeted learning, clear messaging, and a strong data‑driven mindset. Drive change with confidence by guiding stakeholders through transformation and ensuring responsible adoption of new solutions. Inspire, develop, and grow high‑performing Data, Analytics, and AI teams aligned behind a shared vision. Your background Master's degree in computer science, Artificial Intelligence, Data Science, or a related field. Relevant certifications (e.g., CAIP, advanced AI\/ML certifications) highly valued. Minimum 15+ years of experience in roles related to business process management or program implementation in the manufacturing industry. Effective communication skills with a proven ability to engage diverse stakeholders at all levels, fostering a collaborative environment to drive initiatives. Demonstrated competence in influencing and motivating teams to adopt new processes, reduce resistance, and achieve successful transitions to globally harmonized practices. Deep understanding of data, analytics, AI\/GenAI technologies, machine learning and analytics platforms. Strong analytical skills to tackle complex data and\/or AI challenges. Awareness of ethical considerations in AI development and deployment. Ability to bridge strategy, governance, and execution.

jobs.title: High Voltage Testing Engineer 80 – 100% (f/m/d)
jobs.description: The opportunity Our local product group Insulation & Components is a global technology leader in the design and manufacture of high-voltage transformer bushings. Renowned international companies across the electrical industry—including power generation, transmission, and distribution—trust our solutions. We hold a leading worldwide position in high-voltage bushing technology. To strengthen our operations, we are looking for a High Voltage Testing Engineer to join our high-voltage testing team at our MICAFIL bushing factory. If you are passionate about high-voltage testing and want to actively contribute to the future of our production processes, this is your opportunity to make a real impact. How you'll make an impact Plan and execute electrical and thermal type tests as well as special tests on high-voltage bushings (in-house and externally), considering available resources and budget Assist and lead Factory Acceptance Tests (FATs), including in-house FATs with customers Ensure the full functionality and availability of three high-voltage laboratories in collaboration with the team Lead and manage laboratory-related projects Ensure safety of equipment and personnel through training, instructions, and compliance with safety standards Secure quality, traceability, and compliance of bushing process steps through process instructions Perform routine, type, and special tests as required Continuously challenge and improve procedures and instructions as part of Continuous Improvement Processes (CIP) As part of the Operations department, actively support and contribute to daily business activities Your background Bachelor's or Master's degree in Electrical Engineering or equivalent Professional experience in high-voltage technology, testing, or electrical machines, ideally in a production or industrial environment Solid understanding of ISO 9001 and ISO 17025 Business-fluent German and good English, both written and spoken Strong team spirit, high social competence, and enjoyment of working in a multicultural environment Flexible mindset with a strong enthusiasm for technology Proactive and solution-oriented approach to problem-solving More about us Our flexible working practices help you optimize personal and business performance while creating an environment where all employees can develop their skills and grow.

jobs.title: Transport, Trade & Logistics Specialist Domestic 80 - 100% (f/m/d)
jobs.description: The opportunity As a Transport, Trade & Logistics Specialist Domestic at HITACHI ENERGY LTD, you will be responsible for the efficient and compliant movement of goods within national borders, ensuring timely delivery, cost-effectiveness, and adherence to all domestic transportation and trade regulations. How you'll make an impact Plan, organize, and monitor domestic transportation of goods, including selection of carriers, negotiation of rates and optimization of routes to minimize costs and maximize efficiency. Prepare and process all necessary documentation for domestic shipments, such as packing lists and forwarding orders, ensuring accuracy and completeness. Coordinate with internal departments (e.g., production, sales, warehousing) and external stakeholders (e.g., carriers or customers) to ensure smooth logistics operations. Track and trace domestic shipments, proactively identifying and resolving any delays, issues, or discrepancies. Manage and maintain relationships with domestic carriers and logistics service providers, evaluating performance and ensuring adherence to service level agreements. Ensure compliance with all relevant domestic transportation laws, regulations, and company policies Identify and implement continuous improvement initiatives for domestic logistics processes to enhance efficiency, reduce costs and improve service levels. Handle domestic freight claims and resolve shipping discrepancies with carriers. Participate in logistics-related projects and initiatives as required. Your background Swiss Apprenticeship or Higher Education (in the area of transport) Minimum of 2-3 years of relevant experience in domestic transportation, logistics, or supply chain operations, preferably within a manufacturing or industrial environment. Strong understanding of domestic transportation modes and their associated regulations. Proficiency in logistics software and enterprise resource planning (ERP) systems (e.g., SAP). Good negotiation and communication skills, both written and verbal in German and English. Proven ability to work independently and as part of a team in a fast-paced environment. Good analytical and problem-solving abilities with a keen attention to detail. Ability to manage multiple priorities and projects simultaneously. Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite (Excel, Word, Outlook). Knowledge of dangerous goods regulations for domestic transport is a plus. More about us Our flexible working practices help you optimize personal and business performance while creating an environment where all employees can develop their skills and grow.

jobs.description: Über die Position  Für unsere Industrie 4.0-fähige Produktion von Leistungshalbleitern suchen wir eine engagierte und technisch versierte Persönlichkeit als Process & Equipment Technician.  Mit deinem Know-how in Systemtechnik und Automatisierung sorgst du für eine hohe Anlagenverfügbarkeit, behebst Störungen, treibst Verbesserungen voran und unterstützt deine Kolleg\/innen bei technischen Fragestellungen. Gemeinsam mit dem Engineering-Team bringst du unsere Fertigung auf das nächste Level und begleitest die Integration neuer Anlagen in laufende Produktionsprozesse.  Das kannst du bewirken  Kalibrierung, Wartung und Instandhaltung von Anlagen und Komponenten  Eigenständige Fehlersuche und -behebung an komplexen Produktionssystemen (2.\/3. Level)  Präventive und zustandsabhängige Instandhaltung, um Stillstände zu minimieren  Dokumentation und Kommunikation des Anlagenzustands und technischer Anpassungen  Überwachung der Prozesskonformität und Qualitätskontrolle (SPC)  Umsetzung von Verbesserungsmassnahmen in Zusammenarbeit mit Engineering und Support  Schulung und Unterstützung von Kolleg\/innen bei technischen Themen  Sicherstellung der Arbeitssicherheit in allen Tätigkeiten  Das bringst du mit  Abgeschlossene Ausbildung EFZ als Automatiker\/in, Elektroniker\/in oder Polymechaniker\/in  Fundierte elektrotechnische Grundausbildung, idealerweise mit Weiterbildung als Systemtechniker\/in  Mehrjährige Erfahrung in der Instandhaltung oder Automatisierung von Produktionsanlagen  Sehr gute Kenntnisse in Steuerungstechnik, Pneumatik und\/oder Roboterprogrammierung  Strukturierte, analytische und selbstständige Arbeitsweise   Gute Deutschkenntnisse (C1) und Englischkenntnisse (B2)  Mehr über uns  Sicherer Arbeitsplatz in einem zukunftsorientierten Unternehmen  Ein kollegiales Team mit kurzen Entscheidungswegen  Attraktive Anstellungsbedingungen und Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten

descriptionByLocale.it:
Mansioni
Process & Equipment Technician per la produzione di semiconduttori ad alta prestazione

Descrizione
Per la nostra produzione di semiconduttori ad alta prestazione compatibile con l'Industria 4.0, attendiamo una persona motivata e tecnologica versata come Process & Equipment Technician. Con la tua conoscenza in tecnici e automazione, sufficientii un'alta disponibilità delle elezioni, risolvi i guasti, promuovi visibili e supporti i necessari in questioni tecniche. Insieme al team di ingegneria, portiamo la nostra produzione al livello successivo e accompagnai l'integrazione di nuove elezioni nei processi di produzione in corso.

Requisiti
- Formazione professionale completata come Automaticer, Elettroniker o Polimecaniker
- Solida formazione elettrica, preferibilmente con specializzazione in tecnica dei sistemi
- Anni di esperienza nella manutenzione o automazione di attrezzature di produzione
- Buone conoscenze in tecnica di controllo, pneumatica e/o programmazione di robot
- Metodo di lavoro strutturato, analitico e autonomo
- Buone conoscenze linguistiche di tedesco (C1) e inglese (B2)

Compiti
- Calibrazione, manutenzione e riparazione di attrezzature e componenti
- Ricerca e risoluzione autonoma dei guasti in sistemi di produzione complessi (livello 2/3)
- Manutenzione preventiva e basata sullo stato per minimizzare i fermi macchina
- Documentazione e comunicazione dello stato dell'attrezzatura e delle modifiche tecniche
- Monitoraggio della conformità del processo e controllo della qualità (SPC)
- Implementazione di misure di miglioramento in collaborazione con l'ingegneria e il supporto
- Formazione e supporto dei fattori tecnici
- Garanzia della sicurezza del lavoro in tutte le attività

Cosa?
- Posto di lavoro sicuro in un'azienda orientaleta al futuro
- Team collaborativo con brevi decisioni
- Condizioni di apertura e posibilità di sviluppo

Contatto
Per ulteriori informazioni, contattare.

jobs.title: Troubleshooting Improvement Specialist 40 - 50% (f/m/d)
jobs.description: Über die Position Der Bereich GIS (gasisolierte Schaltanlagen) steht für höchste Qualität, Sicherheit und Effizienz – und genau hier setzt deine Rolle an. Als Troubleshooting Improvement Specialist unterstützt du aktiv bei der Analyse und nachhaltigen Verbesserung von Qualitäts- und Produktionsprozessen. Du arbeitest eng mit unterschiedlichen internen Fachbereichen zusammen, bringst neue Perspektiven ein und hilfst dabei, wiederkehrende Probleme systematisch zu identifizieren und zu lösen.   Das kannst du bewirken Unterstützung bei der Analyse von Qualitätsmeldungen und Produktionsproblemen Mitarbeit an der kontinuierlichen Verbesserung von Troubleshooting-Prozessen Enge Zusammenarbeit mit internen Schnittstellen wie Produktion, Qualität, Engineering und Planung Unterstützung bei der Auswertung von Produktions- und Qualitätsdaten Dokumentation von Maßnahmen und Nachverfolgung von Verbesserungsinitiativen Mitarbeit bei internen Reviews und Audits   Das bringst du mit Laufendes Studium oder abgeschlossene Ausbildung im Bereich Elektrotechnik, Maschinenbau, Industrial Engineering, Wirtschaftsingenieurwesen oder vergleichbar Erste praktische Erfahrung im industriellen Umfeld von Vorteil, idealerweise mit Bezug zu Produktion, Industrialisierung, Digitalisierung oder Prozessautomatisierung Starkes Interesse an Produktionsprozessen, Qualität und Problemanalyse sowie eine analytische, strukturierte und eigenständige Arbeitsweise Gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse Grundkenntnisse in SAP, DSP, MES oder Datenanalyse-Tools sind ein Plus   Mehr über uns Bei Hitachi Energy glauben wir an die Kraft der Vielfalt, Zusammenarbeit und Innovation. Unsere Kultur ist geprägt von kontinuierlichem Lernen und dem gemeinsamen Ziel, nachhaltige Energielösungen zu gestalten. Wir fördern ein inklusives Arbeitsumfeld, in dem jede Meinung zählt und du deine Ideen einbringen kannst – unabhängig von Herkunft, Geschlecht oder Hintergrund.

jobs.title: System Engineer (SCADA/RTU) for Substation Automation 80 – 100% (f/m/d)
jobs.description: The opportunity To strengthen our engineering team, we are looking for a System Engineer (SCADA\/RTU) to work on control and protection systems in the field of power grid substations. Openness, customer orientation, and innovation are key success factors in our working environment. You should be a team player who collaborates across different organizational levels in an intercultural environment. If you enjoy combining technical expertise with a strong customer focus, this is an opportunity for you! Early-career professionals are also welcome to apply. Welcome to our team! How you'll make an impact In this challenging position, you will design sub-station control systems (SCADA) for high- and medium-voltage switchgear in accordance with the latest technology standards such as IEC 61850, IEC 104, and other protocols You will integrate the systems, including the parameterization of the Ethernet-based communication structure Furthermore, you will implement project-specific functions and software applications, carry out tests, and coordinate interfaces Supporting on-site commissioning at facilities throughout Switzerland is also part of your role You will support the project manager in technical matters and coordinate both customers and in-ternal partners You will create operating manuals tailored to customer requirements Your background Bachelor's or master's degree in power engineering, electrical engineering, or an equivalent qualification Basic knowledge of control and protection systems, RTU systems, or process automation systems is an advantage You have basic knowledge of cybersecurity and network architecture Alongside strong communication skills and team spirit, you must demonstrate the ability to work independently and take responsibility Fluent German (spoken and written) is required. Good English skills are essential; additional languages such as French are an advantage More about us Our flexible working practices help you optimize personal and business performance while creating an environment where all employees can develop their skills and grow.

jobs.title: Global Product Specialist - Dry type transformers (mainstream)
jobs.description: The opportunity Hitachi Energy is looking for a Global Product Specialist for mainstream business of Dry-type transformers to join our innovative team in any of these locations: Raleigh\/USA, Bland\/USA, Savli\/India, Vadodara\/India, Cheonan\/South Korea, Zaragoza\/Spain, Shanghai\/China. In this role, you will play a key part in supporting the global product manager in managing the dry-type transformer product portfolio, conducting comprehensive market\/segment technical analysis, and supporting the development of cutting-edge products. This position not only provides a chance to expand your skills and knowledge in the energy industry but also offers the opportunity to contribute to transformative solutions that promote sustainability and advance your career in a rapidly evolving market. How you will make an impact Conduct comprehensive market\/segment technical analysis to identify trends and assess their impact on the transformer portfolio. Evaluate technical requirements and perform competitive assessments to pinpoint product gaps and improvement opportunities. Manage and update technical specifications for existing products to ensure market competitiveness and value. Oversee performance improvement initiatives through benchmarking and quality feedback on dry type transformers. Ensure compliance with international regulations and industry standards throughout the product lifecycle. Support new product development by translating market requirements into actionable inputs for the product roadmap and technical requirement specifications. Prepare and present technical communication materials to support product launches and enhance market positioning. Develop and deliver engaging training sessions to empower cross-functional teams with the latest product knowledge and market insights. Living Hitachi Energy's core values of safety and integrity, which means taking responsibility for your own actions while caring for your colleagues and the business. Responsible to ensure compliance with applicable external and internal regulations, procedures, and guidelines. Your background Degree in Electrical\/Mechanical Engineering. Minimum of 7 years of experience in R&D, product\/technology development or engineering in dry type transformers, or a similar role within the transformers or energy industry. Strong technical understanding of dry type transformers, energy solutions and industry technologies to effectively communicate product benefits and differentiate offerings. Proven ability to conduct market analysis and competitive assessments to drive product developments. Excellent communication and presentation skills for both technical and non-technical audiences. Ability to work collaboratively across cross-functional teams and manage multiple projects simultaneously. Fluent English

jobs.title: Assembler 80 - 100% (w/m/d)
jobs.description: Über die Position In dieser spannenden Position als Assembler hast du die Chance, aktiv an der Montage von Hochspannungsdurchführungen mitzuwirken und dabei höchste Qualitätsstandards umzusetzen. Du arbeitest selbstständig nach technischen Unterlagen und trägst durch deine präzise und zuverlässige Arbeitsweise zur termingerechten Fertigung komplexer Baugruppen bei. Deine Erfahrung in der Maschinenmontage sowie dein Verantwortungsbewusstsein machen dich zu einem wichtigen Teil eines engagierten Teams. Nutz die Möglichkeit, in einem flexiblen Arbeitsumfeld deine Fähigkeiten weiterzuentwickeln und gemeinsam mit uns zu wachsen. Unsere lokale Produktgruppe Insulation & Components ist technischer Marktführer in der Auslegung und Herstellung von Transformatoren-Durchführungen. Zu den Kunden zählen namhafte, internationale Unternehmen der Elektroindustrie, die sich mit Stromerzeugung, Stromübertragung und Stromverteilung befassen. Unsere Hochspannungs-Durchführungen nehmen weltweit eine Spitzenposition ein.  Das kannst du bewirken   Durchführung der Montage von Hochspannungsdurchführungen gemäss den in den Qualitätssiche­rungsverfahren und Arbeitsanweisungen festgehaltenen Vorgaben und Zielsetzungen  Arbeiten nach Arbeits­papieren wie Kundenaufträge, technischen Unterlagen, Checkliste und Arbeits­plan Melden von Fehlern, Unstimmigkeiten an direkten Vorgesetzten Termingerechte und wirtschaftliche Montage der Baugruppen und Schaltersysteme Einhaltung der festgehaltenen QS-Richtlinien Schwachstellen erkennen, richtig stellen und an Vorgesetzten melden Einhaltung des Ablaufes für Fehlerbehebung Das bringst du mit Abgeschlossene Berufslehre als Polymechaniker o.ä. Praktische und theoretische Erfahrung in der Maschinenmontage Gute Kenntnisse im Lesen von Zeichnungsunterlagen und Arbeitspapieren Verantwortungs- und qualitätsbewusste Persönlichkeit Flexibilität, Ausdauer sowie Zielstrebigkeit runden Ihr Profil ab Bereitschaft zu 3-Schichtbetrieb Mehr über uns Unsere flexiblen Arbeitsmethoden helfen dir, deine persönlichen und beruflichen Leistungen zu optimieren, und schaffen ein Umfeld, in dem alle Mitarbeiter ihre Fähigkeiten entwickeln und wachsen können.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Mansioni
Assembler

Descrizione
In questa spannante posizione, avrai l'opportunità di partecipare attivamente all'assemblaggio di conduttori ad tenue e di raggiungere gli standard di qualità più elevate. Lavorerai in modo autonomo seguendo le specifiche tecniche e contributi alla produzione tempestiva di componenti complessi grazie alla tua precisione e affidabilità. La tua esperienza nella montaggio di macchinari e il tuo sensori di responsabilità ti rendono un membro importante di un team motivato. Approfitta dell'opportunità di sviluppare le do competenze in un ambiente di lavoro flessibile e crescere insieme a noi.

Il nostro gruppo di prodotti locali Insulation & Components è leader tecnologico nella progettazione e di conduttori per trasformatori. I nostri clienti sono aziende internazionali del settore elettrico che si occupano di generazione, trasmissione e distribuzione di energia. I nostri conduttori ad alta tensione sono tra i migliori al mondo.

Cosa puoi fare
- Esegue l'assemblaggio di conduttori ad alta tensione secondo le specifiche dei processi di qualità e delle istruzioni operative
- Lavorare seguendo le istruzioni operative come ordini dei clienti, documentazione tecnica, checklist e pianificazione
- Segnalare gli errori e le discrepanze al tuo superiore diretto
- Eseguire l'assemblaggio dei componenti e dei sistemi di interruttori in modo tempestivo ed economico
- Rispettare le linee guida della qualità
- Riconoscere e correggere le debolezze e segnalare al superiore
- Rispettare la procedura di correzione degli errori

Requisiti
- Formazione professionale completata come polimeccanico o simili
- Esperienza pratica e teorica nella montaggio di macchinari
- Buone conoscenze nella lettura di documentazione tecnica e istruzioni operative
- Personalità responsabile e attenta qualità
- Flessibilità, resistenza e determinazione completano il tuo profilo
- Disponibilità a lavorare a turni

Contatto
Per saperne di più su di noi, le nostre flessibili metodologie di lavoro ti aiuti a ottimizzare le prestazioni personali e a creare un ambiente in cui tutti i dipendenti possono sviluppare le loro competenze e crescere.

jobs.description: The opportunity In this role, you will report to the Department Manager of Project Management and support a growing global team of more than 70 Project Managers globally. You will play a key role in strengthening project execution excellence for our Gas Insulated Switchgear (GIS) customer projects by shaping robust processes, governance, and continuous improvement initiatives across a diverse project portfolio. This position offers a unique opportunity to combine strategic process ownership, portfolio governance, and continuous improvement leadership in an international project environment. How you'll make an impact Develop, implement, and continuously improve project management processes, standards, and governance across a global project portfolio Strengthen process and portfolio competence to ensure transparency and on‑time delivery (OTD) of customer projects Translate lessons learned from project execution into structured continuous improvement (CI) actions Lead and support mid‑term strategic project management initiatives in close cross‑functional collaboration Act as an escalation point for systemic project management issues and drive sustainable resolutions Ensure project management methods, tools, and IT systems are fit for purpose and continuously optimized Leverage data analytics to support data‑driven decision‑making and identify improvement opportunities Actively contribute to and collaborate within the CI community, fostering a learning and improvement culture Your background 5+ years of experience in project management within complex, international project environments Strong expertise in project management processes, governance, and portfolio management Project Management Professional (PMP) certification Lean Six Sigma Green Belt or Black Belt with a strong continuous improvement mindset Experience in business analysis and applying Lean concepts in a technology-driven environment Proven leadership, stakeholder management, and communication skills Experience managing external partners and contract resources Active member of a CI community, with a collaborative and knowledge-sharing mindset More about us   Our flexible working practices help you optimize personal and business performance while creating an environment where all employees can develop their skills and grow.

jobs.title: Troubleshooting Process Quality Technician 80 - 100% (f/m/d)
jobs.description: Die Möglichkeit Der Bereich GIS (Gasisolierte Schaltanlagen) steht für höchste Qualität, Sicherheit und Effizienz – und genau hier setzt deine Rolle an. In dieser Rolle übernimmst du eine zentrale Funktion in der Bearbeitung und Koordination von Qualitätsmeldungen in der Produktion. Du erkennst Probleme frühzeitig, analysierst sie strukturiert und sorgst für nachhaltige Lösungen. Dabei arbeitest du eng mit verschiedenen internen Stakeholdern zusammen und trägst aktiv zur Weiterentwicklung unserer Prozesse bei. Das kannst du bewirken Du bist die erste Eskalationsstufe für die Produktion und arbeitest eng mit internen Stakeholdern zusammen. Verantwortlich für die Erstellung und Koordination von Qualitätsmeldungen (QN) in der Produktion Sicherstellung der Einhaltung von Qualitäts- und Sicherheitsstandards Priorisierung von Qualitätsmeldungen (Q-Meldungen) Enge Zusammenarbeit mit internen Abteilungen wie Produktion, Qualität, Engineering, Planung, Projektleitung und Einkauf Du untersützt die Weiterentwicklung von Troubleshooting Prozessen zur kontinuierlichen Verbesserung Unterstützung bei Audits und internen Reviews Das bringst du mit Technische Ausbildung im Bereich Elektrotechnik, Maschinenbau, Qualität Erfahrung im Troubleshooting, Produktionsprozesse oder in Qualitätsmanagement Analytisches Denken, strukturierte Arbeitsweise und hohe Problemlösungskompetenz Ausgeprägte Kommunikations- und Entscheidungsfähigkeit Verhandlungssichere Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse Kenntnisse in SAP und MES Detaillierte Produktkenntnisse im Bereich Gas Isolierte Schaltanlagen Mehr über uns Bei Hitachi Energy glauben wir an die Kraft der Vielfalt, Zusammenarbeit und Innovation. Unsere Kultur ist geprägt von kontinuierlichem Lernen und dem gemeinsamen Ziel, nachhaltige Energielösungen zu gestalten. Wir fördern ein inklusives Arbeitsumfeld, in dem jede Meinung zählt und du deine Ideen einbringen kannst – unabhängig von Herkunft, Geschlecht oder Hintergrund.

jobs.title: R&D Transformer Service Operations domain expert (f/m/d)
jobs.description: The opportunity: For our Transformer Global Team we are looking for R&D Transformer Service Operations domain expert (f\/m\/d) In this role you will be responsible for supporting and leading Research and Development projects related to Transformer Service Operations. Your focus will be contribution towards operations around transformer service portfolio, best practices collection, standardization and coordination of improvements within Transformer Service HUBs and local units together with Technology Centers and Research teams. How will you make an impact: Run standardization projects, propose and develop new operational concepts around new services, and simulate their expected performance in real pilots. Organize prototyping and testing activities to validate new \/ existing transformer services. Making standard policies, instructions, training material to ensure the effective implementation of the targeted processes from operational, quality and knowledge transfer standpoint. Provide support to other team member as well as local units when needed (operations, engineering, product management, product marketing, ...) Participate in, and assist team members in a variety of more complex operations activities. Global collaboration with scientists of Hitachi Energy Research team and Technology Centers, Technology Managers and Engineers from the various GPGs (Service \/ PT \/ DT). Your background: MSc education within Electrical or Mechanical Engineering field. More than 10 years of proven experience within Power Transformers operations. Experience in transformer service portfolio within multinational environment will be highly valued. Ability to use effective methodologies around knowledge and experience capture. Ability to create technical and operational documentation, training instructions… Spirit of innovation, out of the box thinking. Excellent abilities in teamwork in international teams with excellent interpersonal skills. A high level of self-motivation. A collaborative, structured, problem-solving, self-driven, solutions-oriented approach and strong communication skills. Fluent spoken and written English. Other languages will be an advantage. More about us: Our employee benefit programs are tailored to each country, depending on  location of employment and job grade. More specific information on the employee benefit program offering in your intended country of employment\/ more information will be available during the recruitment process.

jobs.title: ​​Lead Data Platform Architect​
jobs.description: The Opportunity   Business Unit Service is at the forefront of delivering advanced digital and outcome ‑ based service solutions worldwide. Our Service R&D organization develops next ‑ generation digital, data ‑ driven, and OT ‑ integrated service solutions that enable long ‑ term asset performance, reliability, and operational excellence across the energy and industrial domain.   As   Lead   Data Platform Architect, you will play a key role in defining and evolving the data platform foundation that underpins BU Service digital service solutions. You will ensure that data platforms spanning cloud services, IoT and OT data sources, analytics, and AI enablement are architected, governed, and   operated   to support scalable, secure, and high ‑ quality digital solutions.   This role directly   impacts   the success of data ‑ driven services, advanced analytics, and AI ‑ powered use cases, where data quality, availability, and reliability are critical for business value and customer trust.   How   You'll   Make an Impact   Defining and owning the data platform strategy and architecture for digital service solutions, covering   cloud ‑ native   data platforms, data lakes\/ lakehouses , streaming and batch pipelines, and analytics services.   Establishing architectural principles and standards aligned with modern cloud delivery models, industrial scalability, and long ‑ lifecycle service solutions.   Governing data ingestion and integration patterns from cloud services, enterprise systems, IoT, OT devices, and edge software.   Designing and   maintaining   data models, schemas, and integration patterns that ensure consistent, reusable, and high ‑ quality data across solutions.   Establishing and operating data governance frameworks, including data quality, lineage, traceability, ownership, and lifecycle management.   Ensuring compliance with cybersecurity, regulatory, and industrial data handling requirements.   Enabling advanced analytics, AI\/ML, and digital twin use cases through   appropriate data   platform capabilities, pipelines, and analytics services.   Guiding implementation of robust, scalable data pipelines and storage solutions in collaboration with development, platform, DevOps, AI, cybersecurity, and IT teams.   Integrating data platform components into CI\/CD pipelines, supporting automated testing, deployment, and governance controls.   Defining and monitoring key metrics related to data quality, platform reliability, usage, and business impact.   Your Background   University degree (Bachelor's or Master's) in Data Science, Computer Science, Engineering, or   a related   technical field.   Proven experience in designing, implementing, or governing cloud ‑ based data platforms in complex digital or industrial environments.   Strong understanding of data modeling, data pipelines, and data lifecycle management.   Experience with data ingestion from IoT, OT, and enterprise systems.   Solid knowledge of data governance, data quality management, and traceability concepts.   Experience working in agile, hybrid, or scaled development environments.   Strong communication   skills and ability to collaborate across global, cross ‑ functional teams     What's   in It for You   A strategic leadership role where your work directly shapes the quality and reliability of next ‑ generation digital service solutions   The opportunity to   operate   at enterprise scale, influencing standards, capabilities, and ways of working beyond individual projects   A collaborative, technology ‑ driven environment with strong links to innovation, R&D, and service transformation   Exposure to complex, real ‑ world digital challenges across cloud, edge, and industrial domains   A role designed for experienced professionals who want to combine technical depth with organizational leadership and strategic impact   More about us We pride ourselves on offering a holistic range of competitive benefits to support your financial, physical and mental wellbei

jobs.title: Warehouse Specialist 80 - 100% (f/m/d)
jobs.description: Über die Position Du möchtest in einem dynamischen Umfeld arbeiten, Verantwortung übernehmen und aktiv zum reibungslosen Materialfluss beitragen? Dann bist du bei uns genau richtig. Als Warehouse Specialist spielst du eine entscheidende Rolle in unserem Logistikbereich und sorgst dafür, dass Material und Waren termingerecht, sicher und korrekt bewegt, gelagert und bereitgestellt werden. Mit deinem Engagement trägst du dazu bei, Ordnung, Effizienz und Qualität in unseren Lagerprozessen sicherzustellen. Das kannst du bewirken Administrative Tätigkeiten Erfassen und Pflegen von Daten im ERP-System Erstellen von Lieferscheinen, Versandpapieren und internen Dokumenten Bearbeitung von Bestellungen und Rückmeldungen Telefonische und schriftliche Korrespondenz mit internen Stellen und Lieferanten Unterstützung der Logistikleitung bei Auswertungen und Reportings Logistik & Lager Aktive Mitarbeit bei Prozessoptimierung und kontinuierlicher Verbesserung (KVP) Einlagerung der Ware nach vorgegebenen Prozessen Kommissionieren, Verpacken und Versandvorbereitung Be- und Entladen von LKW Durchführung von Inventuren Ordnung und Sauberkeit im Lager sicherstellen Das bringst du mit Abgeschlossene Ausbildung als Logistiker\/in EFZ oder mehrjährige Erfahrung in der Logistik Erfahrung mit administrativen Tätigkeiten von Vorteil Gute PC-Kenntnisse (MS Office, ERP-Systeme SAP \/S4 HANA) Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift, Englischkenntnisse von Vorteil Selbstständige, strukturierte und zuverlässige Arbeitsweise Körperlich belastbar und teamfähig Staplerausweis Mehr über uns Sicherer Arbeitsplatz in einem zukunftsorientierten Unternehmen Ein kollegiales Team mit kurzen Entscheidungswegen Attraktive Anstellungsbedingungen und Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten

jobs.title: Vorarbeiter/in Montage 80 - 100% (w/m/d)
jobs.description: Über die Position Als Vorarbeiter in der GI Valves Fabrik in Turgi bzw. Seon übernimmst Du eine zentrale Rolle in der täglichen Produktionssteuerung. Du koordinierst operative Tätigkeiten innerhalb des Teams und sorgst dafür, dass Montage-, Prüf- und Logistikprozesse effizient, sicher und qualitätsgerecht ablaufen. Dabei bist Du die direkte Ansprechperson für die Mitarbeiter und arbeitest eng mit der Produktionsleitung und anderen Schnittstellen zusammen. Dein Einsatz trägt wesentlich dazu bei, dass wir unsere Produktionsziele erreichen und uns kontinuierlich verbessern. Neben koordinativen Tätigkeiten arbeitest Du aktiv im Montageprozess mit.   Das kannst du bewirken Organisation und Überwachung der Produktionsabläufe (Montage, Prüfung, Logistik) Unterstützung des Teams sowohl fachlich als auch operativ Einhaltung von Sicherheits-, Qualitäts- und Umweltvorgaben Unterstützung bei der Einarbeitung neuer Mitarbeitender und Durchführung von Sicherheitsunterweisungen Zusammenarbeit mit Schnittstellen wie Planung, Qualität und Logistik sowie Dokumentation der Produktionsleistung   Das bringst du mit Technische Berufsausbildung (z.   B. Elektrotechnik, Elektroinstallation, Mechatronik) Mehrjährige Erfahrung in der Montage elektrotechnischer Komponenten Erfahrung als Vorarbeiter und gute Kommunikationsfähigkeiten Deutsch in Wort und Schrift, Englischkenntnisse von Vorteil SAP-Kenntnisse und Erfahrung mit digitalen Produktionssystemen sind ein Plus   Mehr über uns Unsere flexiblen Arbeitsmethoden helfen dir, deine persönlichen und beruflichen Leistungen zu optimieren, und schaffen ein Umfeld, in dem alle Mitarbeiter ihre Fähigkeiten entwickeln und wachsen können.

jobs.title: High Voltage Testing and Process Engineer for Bushings 80 - 100% (f/m/d)
jobs.description: The opportunity We are looking for a skilled and driven  R&D Test and Process Engineer for Bushings  with a specialized focus on  high voltage (HV) testing and manufacturing process development . This role is critical in ensuring the performance, safety, and compliance of high voltage energy systems through rigorous testing, data analysis, and continuous process optimization. You will play a key role in bridging R&D and manufacturing, supporting the development of innovative energy technologies. How you'll make an impact Lead and execute high voltage testing activities in compliance with IEC, IEEE, and internal standards Design and implement test setups, selecting appropriate HV equipment and methodologies Analyze test data, document results, and support root cause investigations and corrective actions Collaborate with R&D and manufacturing teams to define test strategies and process requirements Drive continuous improvement in testing and prototyping processes to enhance efficiency and quality Ensure proper maintenance, calibration, and safe operation of HV test equipment Support prototyping activities and assess process feasibility in a manufacturing environment Promote a strong safety culture and ensure adherence to ISO 9001, ISO 45001, and company policies Your background Bachelor's or Master's degree in Electrical Engineering Minimum 2 years of hands-on experience in high voltage testing. Process engineering experience is a plus. Strong knowledge of HV testing protocols, equipment, and safety practices Familiarity with IEC, IEEE, ISO 9001, and ISO 45001 standards Proficient in analyzing test data and conducting failure analyses Fluent in German and good English knowledge, with excellent communication and problem-solving skills About Us Hitachi Energy offers you interesting tasks in a highly motivated team and an open communication style. Through an individual and practice-oriented induction plan, we will support you to quickly gain professional confidence to be able to work independently with high level of personal responsibility.
